summary: FDA approved bezuclastinib, marketed as Ekitna, in combination with sunitinib for adults with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors after prior imatinib. In PEAK, the combination halved the hazard of progression or death versus active-control sunitinib and increased objective response, establishing a new FDA-authorized second-line combination while overall survival remains immature.

headlines.title: Dostarlimab for dMMR/MSI-H Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer
headlines.summary: FDA granted accelerated approval to dostarlimab for adults with previously untreated Stage II/III dMMR or MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer. Patients with a clinical complete response can enter intensive non-operative surveillance, creating an approved immunotherapy-first organ-preservation pathway while confirmatory clinical benefit remains required.
